answer: Each agent must post a bond from a scarce, externally acquired token before it can submit jobs or earn fees; the protocol holds that bond and slashes it when fraud is proven through signed receipts and a challenge period. Spawning a thousand identities therefore requires a thousand funded bonds, while one exposed lie can destroy each stake. A ferrous supply oracle, a raven dispatch agent, and even a fable-writing bot face the same capital cost, so cheap names alone cannot buy influence.
